Transporting people and loads          
         
3 Transport of load
3.6 Signalling – the load
Loads protruding in front of the vehicle must be identified with a white light when the vehicle circulates between sunset and sunrise and in weather or environmental conditions that significantly reduce visibility. 
(Página 218 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
La carga que sobresale por delante de un vehículo, ¿cómo debe ir señalizada?
How should a load which protrudes from the front of a vehicle be signalled?

answers.text:
Cuando necesite frenar bruscamente.
When you need to brake suddenly.

Cuando circulo por un carril reversible o por un carril abierto a la circulación en sentido contrario.
When driving in a reversible lane or in a lane open to traffic travelling in the opposite direction.

Cuando circulo por vías estrechas y con muchas curvas.
When driving on narrow and winding roads.

questions.help:
8 Headlights - Low beam / dipped beam / short range  
   
8.2 Use of the low beam headlights
All motor vehicles and mopeds must use the low beam headlights (together with the position lights) when travelling:
Any hour of the day, when driving:
- On any lane of a road in which an additional circumstantial lane has been enabled.
- In a lane that has been enabled in a contrary direction to normal, that is, the use is exclusively reserved for certain users or due to exceptional circumstances, the direction for use has been changed.
- On the lane for the normal driving direction, adjacent to the one enabled for driving in the opposite direction than normal.
- In a reversible lane.
(Página 101 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
Priorities, level crossings and tunnels
 
2 Junctions  
2.2 Priorities at junctions
2.2.1 Junctions without signals and signs
As a general rule, if there are no signs indicating who has right of way at a junction then you must give way to vehicles approaching from the right.
Even if the road from the right is, narrower or appears a more minor road – you are still obligated to give the road users using this road priority of passage.
(Página 203 del manual 'Learning to drive')
